observations.content: User (Vietnamese, writing in Vietnamese) is preparing for the APTIS exam and asked the assistant to proactively search for scoring rubrics (barem điểm), test-taking strategies, and study materials to get high scores, and to use the teach skill to assess their ability first.
User has an APTIS folder with materials including APTIS.md and two zips: 'Tài liệu APTIS' and 'WRITING APTIS'.

The teach skill was loaded; it defines two principles (unconditional truths first, and 'how could I have discovered this?') plus a three-phase process (probe quiz/ask_user_question, plan with researcher and mermaid dependency map, teach node loop) and rules for writing quiz options.
om_status reported healthy: 1 slice (~5.8k tok) waiting to summarize, context 14,926/150,000 tok, no topics yet.

'Tài liệu APTIS' zip contains Listening audio (Question 1-17 .m4a files), Speaking materials (SPEAKING.docx, APTIS SPEAK 1/2 pdfs, speak-đã-dịch.docx, p2.docx), Grammar ver 2.docx, Writing and Reading practice PDFs, mock tests, 'mẹo aptis.docx' and 'mẹo aptis.mp3', and Vietnamese answer keys (ĐÁP ÁN) for Reading/Vocabulary/Listening practice.
'WRITING APTIS' zip contains 33 writing club practice docx files (FILM CLUB, TECHNOLOGY CLUB, ENGLISH CLUB, CINEMA CLUB, MUSEUM CLUB, and others) plus COLLEGE.docx.
APTIS.md file content only echoed the user's original request about preparing for APTIS and wanting the assistant to search for materials and assess ability.

Assistant planned to respond in Vietnamese, explore the APTIS folder, spawn a researcher subagent to gather APTIS scoring system, format, rubrics, strategies and free official materials, then run teach Phase 1 probe with quiz plus ask_user_question about goal.
